description: This file defines the IMediaPipeline interface and related classes for media playback in the Rialto framework. It includes class definitions for media sources, media segments, and the media pipeline API, including methods for loading media, attaching sources, controlling playback, and querying status.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaPipeline instances, returns a concrete implementation.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline
classes.description: Interface defining the public API for media playback, including media source management, playback controls, and status queries.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSource
classes.description: Abstract class representing a media data source, with derived classes for audio, video, and Dolby Vision sources.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSourceAudio
classes.description: Represents an audio media source with specific audio configuration.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSourceVideo
classes.description: Represents a video media source with width, height, and frame rate.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSourceVideoDolbyVision
classes.description: Represents a Dolby Vision video media source with a specific profile.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSegment
classes.description: Represents a media segment with timestamp, duration, and encryption info.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSegmentAudio
classes.description: Represents an audio media segment with sample rate and channel info.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSegmentVideo
classes.description: Represents a video media segment with width, height, and frame rate.

classes.name: IMediaPipeline::MediaSegmentVideoDolbyVision
classes.description: Represents a Dolby Vision video media segment with profile info.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaPipeline instance with a client and video requirements.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline's client.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Notifies that all sources have been attached.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the display rectangle for video.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates data is needed for media streaming.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment in response to data requests.
